title: Integration Guide
subtitle: Open API onboarding: app creation, authentication and call examples

flow.title: Onboarding Flow
flow.step1: Admin syncs API list from knife4j in "API Management" and opens the APIs to expose.
flow.step2: Create an app in "App Management"; AppKey/AppSecret are generated automatically (secret visible only on create/reset).
flow.step3: Grant APIs to the app in "Authorization"; unauthorized APIs are rejected with 403.
flow.step4: Call APIs with the four auth headers; the signature string must match the backend URI (without the /api gateway prefix).
flow.step5: See "Error Codes" on 401/403; reset the secret immediately if leaked.
flow.h2: Millisecond timestamp, server allows ±5 min drift
flow.h3: One-time nonce (UUID), not reusable within 10 minutes

errors.e401: Unknown AppKey / missing headers / timestamp drift / replayed nonce / signature mismatch.
errors.e403: App disabled, or API not opened / not granted to this app.
errors.tip: Note: use the backend path (e.g. /requirement/products) in the signature string, without the /api prefix.
